lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance, approximately circular pixel clusters are visible along the mid-lateral flank, with a primary concentration of roughly 12-15 prominent spots arranged posterior to the pectoral fin base.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Discrete vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible intersecting the horizontal spot rows, creating a defined grid-like arrangement across the mid-to-posterior flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper third of the lateral flank, characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient transition from high-luminance upper edges to high-shadow lower boundaries.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent dark, jagged linear mark is visible on the mid-posterior lateral flank, indicating a site of potential physical trauma or a deep scar.
other_distinctive_markers: A large circular watermark logo is superimposed over the dorsal fin and upper posterior flank. A dark, elongated silhouette consistent with a remora is visible attached or swimming closely beneath the ventral side of the mid-flank.
